title: The free 'weigh what this grief asks' action is explicitly labeled '(free)' at Thornwold's Gallows Glade and Hollowbrook's Old Court (confirmed: turn counter did not advance), but the equivalent 'weigh what each choice would mean' at the Vale's Barrow Throne carries no '(free)' tag and did cost a turn (127->128).
